Name: Tractor Mod - Tractor Recolor
Author: paradigmnomad
Description:
[left]As the title says, this is a simple recolor and slight redesign of the tractor sprite in Pathoschilds' [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401/?]Tractor Mod[/url].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Eqdpuvd.png[/img]

- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401/?]Tractor Mod
[/url]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/LKwk9jp.png[/img]

Feel free to improve on the design if you would like
Current colors:
 -red
- green
- blue
- yellow
- orange
- white
- purple
- grey
- camo
+ (3/2) More colors have been added!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kLbxt2U.png[/img]﻿

- After installing Tractor Mod navigate to Stardew Valley/Mods/ Tractor Mod/Assets
- Select which color you would like (ex. tractor_white.png) and rename it to tractor.png
- This will override the current tractor design included with Tractor Mod so make sure to back it up

You should now have a fancy new tractor![/left]

Downloads.Description: Adds a bunch of new, simple colors.
